description: Blank 3HP panel carrying a vector generator: its two outputs trace a logo on a scope in X-Y mode, continuously rather than from a stored image, so it can be scanned slowly or pushed to audio rate

params.text: Sets how fast the shape is traced, from a slow outline at the bottom of its range up to audio rate at the top
Scales the drawing along the horizontal axis, which stretches or squashes the shape
Scales the drawing along the vertical axis, which stretches or squashes the shape

outputs.text: The horizontal coordinate of the drawing, which needs the vertical one patched as well for the shape to make sense
The vertical coordinate of the drawing, which needs the horizontal one patched as well for the shape to make sense

notes: the generator runs only while something is patched to an output
menu: Shape — picks the logo the two outputs draw: Vult, Omri Cohen, VCV, Pete, Chuck, Circadian or WavHead
